markers.name: This Is the Place Monument
markers.note: Marks the monument itself; the vanguard's canyon-mouth camp of 21 July 1847 is described only as 'at the mouth of Emigration Canyon' and is folded in here.

markers.name: First valley camp, Parley's Creek (1700 S / 500 E)
markers.coord_source: OSM: shared node of 1700 South and 500 East; position from Ensign July 1997 ('near present-day 1700 South and 500 East')
markers.note: Sources give only a nearby intersection; the camp site itself was not recorded.

markers.name: City Creek camp of 23 July 1847 (Main-State, 300-400 S)
markers.coord_source: Centre of the block bounded by Main, State, 300 South and 400 South (OSM intersection nodes); position from Ensign July 1997
markers.note: Sources name the block only; marker at the block centre.

markers.name: Temple Square (temple, Tabernacle, Assembly Hall, Beehive and Lion Houses)
markers.coord_source: Temple coordinates given in the brief

markers.name: Old Fort site, Pioneer Park
markers.coord_source: OSM way 172843732 (Pioneer Park) centroid; NRHP 74001938 places the fort site at Pioneer Park

markers.name: Temple Quarry, Little Cottonwood Canyon
markers.coord_source: OSM way 223936008 (Temple Quarry Interpretive Trail) centroid; Ensign Oct 1975 and Church News 2004 place the quarry at the canyon mouth
markers.note: Quarry ground spread along the canyon floor; marker on the interpretive trail through the pits.
